name: Hindoostan Mills Limited
about: Hindoostan Mills Limited engages in engineering business in India and internationally. It offers refiling of elastic calendar bowls, calendaring machines, squeeze rolls, and related products for the textile, paper, and steel industries. The company also provides cotton/comber, polyamide, wool paper, hard chrome, laxmi helextra, ECK NCCM, flax paper, and design roll, as well as wiper bar. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Sirdar Carbonic Gas Company Ltd. and changed its name to Hindoostan Mills Limited in May 2011. Hindoostan Mills Limited was founded in 1873 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
